title: 第7章 夫人你怎么又怀孕了第8章 笑我是冤大头其实我是借你命一用
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 两侧岩壁上镶嵌着发光的萤石。
将这里照得幽暗而诡异，摊位杂乱无章。
摆摊修士大多遮头盖脸，但也有固定店面的店家。
摆摊的修士背景比较弱。
但是那些固定店面的店家，能稳定在黑市存在，都是背景相当强大的。
黑市卖的东西也是五花八门。
有杀人越货染血法器，有来路不明的丹药，甚至还有被锁链锁着的女修。这些女修一般都是被卖来当炉鼎的，炉鼎在修炼界有很大的市场，基本上一出现，就很快会被买走。
李长生瞥了一眼被铁链绑着的炉鼎。
被人抓来当炉鼎真是可怜啊？
李长生想到一个问题，如果自己不够强的话，以后江翠萍和宁宁，会不会也沦落到这个下场？
绝不能让这种事情发生。
李长生想着想着，道心越发坚定。
随意走到一个收灵符的摊位前面。
摊主是个浑身裹在黑袍里的老头，面前摆着几块不知名的矿石，和残缺的法决，旁边立着一块牌子，上面写着牛四收灵符。
牛四抬起眼皮，扫了眼前的黑大汉一眼，面无表情地回答：
李长生袖袍一挥，三张泛着淡金色流光的灵符，落在摊位上。
牛四伸出手抓起一张灵符，
这灵符的防御力比二阶的金刚符还要强三成。
牛四抬头，看着李长生，淡淡地问：“道友，这灵符是你画的？”
李长生冷哼一声：“不该问的别问。”
牛四闻言，讪笑一声，自己坏了规矩，连忙换上笑脸：
“市面上二阶符箓一般是二十灵石一张，老朽出二十五一张，你看如何？”
content_en:
There is a unique cave in the mine.
The rock walls on both sides are inlaid with luminous fluorite.
It makes the place dark and strange, and the stalls are messy.
Most of the monks who run stalls cover their heads, but there are also shops with fixed storefronts.
The monks who set up stalls have relatively weak backgrounds.
But those stores with fixed stores that can stably exist in the black market have a very strong background.
There are also a wide variety of things sold on the black market.
There are blood-stained magic weapons for killing people, elixirs of unknown origin, and even female nuns who are chained. These female cultivators are usually sold as furnace cauldrons. There is a huge market in the cultivation world for furnace cauldrons. Basically, as soon as they appear, they will be bought up quickly.
Li Changsheng glanced at the furnace cauldron tied with iron chains.
I couldn't help but frown.
Such a smooth girl.
Isn't it really pitiful to be caught and used as a furnace?
suddenly.
Li Changsheng thought of a question. If he was not strong enough, would Jiang Cuiping and Ning Ning end up in the same fate in the future?
Um?
So...
I want to become stronger.
This must not be allowed to happen.
As Li Changsheng thought about it, his Taoist heart became more determined.
moment.
Then take a deep breath.
Suppress your emotions.
Randomly walk to a stall that collects talismans.
The owner of the stall is an old man wrapped in a black robe. In front of him are several unknown ores and incomplete spells. Next to it is a sign that reads Niu Si Sheng Talisman.
"Collect the talisman?"
Li Changsheng asked in a low voice.
Niu Si raised his eyelids, glanced at the big black man in front of him, and replied expressionlessly:
"Take it."
Li Changsheng waved his sleeves, and three talismans glowing with light golden light landed on the stall.
Niu Si stretched out his hand and grabbed a magic talisman.
Look carefully.
His eyes suddenly widened.
Is this a second-order diamond talisman?
wrong.
The defensive power of this spiritual talisman is 30% stronger than the second-level diamond talisman.
What a good thing!
Niu Si raised his head, looked at Li Changsheng, and asked calmly: "Fellow Taoist, did you draw this talisman?"
Li Changsheng snorted coldly: "Don't ask what you shouldn't ask."
Niu Si heard this and laughed sarcastically. He broke the rules and quickly put on a smiling face:
"It's just old age and rudeness."
"This talisman is of excellent quality."
"I'll take it."
"The second-level talismans on the market usually cost 20 spirit stones each, but Lao Chan offers 25 spiritual stones each. What do you think?"
Li Changsheng sneered in his heart.
What a profiteer!
